facts.fact: The BCEAO communique of 25 June 2026 sets 30 September 2026 as the deadline for banks, electronic money institutions and payment institutions of the Union to connect to and open services on the PI-SPI instant payment platform, and 30 June 2027 for microfinance institutions under the UMOA Banking Commission, replacing an earlier 30 June 2026 date.

systems.country_label: Plateforme Interoperable du Systeme de Paiement Instantane de l'UEMOA
